text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kvcache_continuous_batch_kv_growth (us-west-2) triggered at 2026-03-15T12:00Z — 95th latency > 800ms, insertion rate spike, eviction rate low. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/4321

sanjay (oncall): ack — I'm on pager. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. any recent rollouts?

julia (eng-runtime): on it. pulling kvcache logs now. preliminary: a sustained spike in KV insert / duplicate keys when speculative decoding + continuous batching enabled in the canary pool. seems like draft/target sync mismatch creating repeated draft inserts.

michael (eng-ml): can confirm: speculative decoding rollout to canary-us-west started ~20m before alert. we had a small experiment enabling speculative drafts with speculative_similarity_threshold=0.6.

lia (customer-success): heads-up: one paid customer (acme-corp) reported increased tail latency for embeddings endpoints in us-west ~12:05. their traffic is routed to the canary pool.

julia (eng-runtime): triage notes:
- KV cache insert rate increased 5x
- Mem pressure rising on the pool (node kvcache heap to 92%)
- Evictions haven't kept up -> bloom filter saturation 
- Batching queue size climbed -> throughput drops -> cascading latency

kevin (eng-sre): adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-batch-incident
Follow steps 1-3 for emergency mitigation.

sanjay (oncall): immediate mitigation options?

julia (eng-runtime): propose quick mitigations (in order):
1) disable speculative decoding on canary pool (fast config flip)
2) reduce target_batch_size from 32 -> 8 for the pool to reduce KV thrash
3) enable immediate kvcache aggressive eviction (ttl 60s)
4) scale up pool nodes as fallback

michael (eng-ml): disabling speculative should stop duplicate draft churn. batching reduction reduces insert bursts. both are safe for canary.

julia (eng-runtime): executing step 1 now.
```bash
# disable speculative decoding for canary-us-west
redwoodctl feature-flag set speculative_decoding=false --pool canary-us-west --by oncall
```

ops-bot: deploy-started canary-us-west 1921120050 by julia

julia (eng-runtime): step 1 done — speculative flipped off. monitoring.

sanjay (oncall): lia, can you confirm whether acme-corp impact reduces once these changes propagate?

lia (customer-success): pinged acme support channel and their SRE. they're seeing some improvement but still elevated at 12:10; waiting for full propagation.

julia (eng-runtime): moving to step 2 — lowering batch size. applying a fast config patch.
```bash
# reduce batch size to limit KV write amplification
redwoodctl routes set-config --pool canary-us-west --target-batch-size 8 --apply-now --reason "mitigation kvcache thrash"
```

ops-bot: config-change applied canary-us-west 1921120188 by julia

julia (eng-runtime): batch change applied. I'm watching kvcache metrics: insert rate down ~65% in last 2 min; eviction count rising (good).

kevin (eng-sre): temporarily bumping eviction aggressiveness per runbook to drain backlog.
```bash
redwoodctl kvcache set-eviction --pool canary-us-west --policy aggressive --ttl 60s
```

ops-bot: kvcache-eviction-updated canary-us-west 1921120302 by kevin

michael (eng-ml): telemetry shows draft/target mismatch errors falling. looks like the root was speculative drafts being materialized into KV before target confirmation, and continuous batching amplified writes.

lia (customer-success): acme reports 80% reduction in tail latency at 12:14, still watching. they asked for ETA to normal — any estimate?

julia (eng-runtime): if current trends hold, expect stabilization in ~10–15 minutes. will confirm once 95/99 latencies are back under SLO.

sanjay (oncall): status update for pager: mitigations applied: speculative decoding disabled, batch size reduced (32->8), eviction TTL set to 60s. scaling not needed at this time.

kevin (eng-sre): creating short-lived alert suppression for noisy signal once backend drains to avoid paging loops.
```bash
alertctl suppress --alert kvcache_continuous_batch_kv_growth --until 1921120800 --by oncall
```

ops-bot: alert-suppression-created 1921120400 by kevin

julia (eng-runtime): running scrub job to remove stale KV duplicates after eviction drains to speed recovery — non-blocking.

michael (eng-ml): action item: revert speculative rollout until we have a fix to guard against draft->kv materialization when target isn't confirmed. I will create a small patch to gate KV writes behind confirmation or dedupe by request-id.

lia (customer-success): acme confirms near-normal metrics at 12:22. thanks team.

sanjay (oncall): handing off to eng-runtime for postmortem and follow-ups. oncall clear for now, will remain reachable.

julia (eng-runtime): handoff ack. follow-ups:
- short postmortem and RCA (include correlation to speculative experiment)
- revert canary config once patch/live test ready
- add additional telemetry counters for draft vs target KV writes
- explicit guard in runtime to avoid duplicate KV inserts when speculative is enabled

michael (eng-ml): I'll own the speculative feature rollback and patch. putting PR and test plan in #eng-ml by EOD.

kevin (eng-sre): I'll update the runbook with the new mitigation sequence (disable speculative -> shrink batch -> increase eviction) and add a checklist for customer notification steps.

lia (customer-success): I'll follow up with acme to close the loop and offer RCA when ready.

sanjay (oncall): last check: all primary metrics trending down, customer impacted ok. closing pager, leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-ack-resolve recorded 1921123450 by sanjay

julia (eng-runtime): adding final snippet of relevant log for postmortem: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:03:12Z] pool=canary-us-west kvcache.insert request_id=abc123 draft=true target_confirmed=false key=k:phrase:987 size=512
[2026-03-15T12:03:12Z] pool=canary-us-west kvcache.insert request_id=abc124 draft=true target_confirmed=false key=k:phrase:988 size=512
[2026-03-15T12:03:13Z] kvcache.insert rate=1023/s mem=14.9GB evictions=12
```

julia (eng-runtime): will drop full RCA + timeline into #incidents later today.

michael (eng-ml): noting for PMs: speculative decoding still promising; need stronger KV write dedupe & gating.

lia (customer-success): thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer comms.

sanjay (oncall): closing out. great coordinated response.
